podcast.body: Otis Blackwell wrote this song specifically for Little Willie John. "At this time, Blackwell had just written the song Fever, for Little Willie John."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.body: This hit song was written by Otis Blackwell. "Blackwell had written Fever for Little Willie John, You're the Apple of My Eye for Frankie Valley, and two massive hits for Elvis, Don't Be Cruel and All Shook Up."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
